scenario:
An international motorsport organization is creating an enterprise-level Racing Event Management System to handle various aspects of organizing and managing racing events. The system will support multiple racing series and events, tracking driver performances, race results, and point standings across different races and seasons.

The platform should manage detailed information about drivers, including their hometowns and car numbers, and allow for the tracking of their performance in individual races. Each race event will record the starting position, finishing position, and any positional changes during the race. The system will also calculate the time differences between drivers and assign points based on their final standings.

The organization requires robust reporting tools to analyze driver performances, track point standings throughout the season, and identify trends and patterns in race results. The system should support a wide variety of user roles, including race officials, team managers, and fans, with appropriate access controls to view or manage data. Additionally, the platform should facilitate the planning and logistics of racing events, including scheduling, venue management, and communication with teams and drivers.
